rules.displayedAttackPurpose: primary visible offensive anchor for early relative scoring; final damage also requires skills and offensive modifiers
rules.displayedDefensePurpose: used by monster simulation for frontline survival diagnostics and placement; weight remains zero in Wanted Code offense scoring
rules.displayedHpPurpose: used by monster simulation for frontline survival diagnostics and placement; weight remains zero in Wanted Code offense scoring
rules.displayedPowerPurpose: reference/diagnostic only; never used as a direct optimization score
rules.monsterDamagePctPurpose: optional hero-specific current self bonus against monsters when displayed or otherwise verified; applies only in monster-compatible PvE contexts
rules.pveDamagePctPurpose: optional current generic PvE damage bonus when displayed or otherwise verified
rules.positionalPveBuffPurpose: current value for an audited positional PvE skill. Duration/cooldown are also required when the skill is timed, such as SSR Sarah MG Symphony; passive effects such as Mason or UR Sarah do not need them
rules.teamAttackBuffPurpose: current all-team Attack buff value/duration/cooldown for audited skills such as Marshall Command Strategy. Timed effects use average uptime until timeline calibration
rules.typeAttackBuffPurpose: current troop-type Attack buff value/duration/cooldown for audited skills such as UR Sarah Airspace Supremacy
rules.highestAtkSkillCooldownSpeedPurpose: diagnostic input for effects such as Marshall Rapid Start; currently stored but not scored because skill-damage share is not calibrated
rules.monsterDamageReductionPurpose: survival diagnostic only; not added to offensive score
rules.frontRowMonsterDamageReductionPurpose: timed survival diagnostic for front-row mitigation such as Elsa Armor Boost; not converted into fake Power

gearInventory.optimizationRule: a gear item can be assigned to only one hero across simultaneous squads

exclusiveWeapons.note: EW effects and same-type specialist bonuses are hero-specific and follow the hero

inputStrategies: fallback: aggregate Tank/Aircraft/Missile ATK/DEF/HP bonuses if player prefers
wallOfHonor.effect: hero entries can buff all heroes of the same troop type

globalDroneLevel.relativeRankingDefault: common/excluded unless objective needs absolute score

overlords.assignmentRule: each Overlord can be assigned to at most one squad at a time
